verdict.rationale: Unit clearly exposes a documented public API (platform overview points to 'Explore the API', webhook events docs, and dashboard/API references for accounts, cards, payments, lending) confirming the platform is API-driven rather than UI-only. However, probes found no discoverable OpenAPI/Swagger spec and a 404 on a docs markdown endpoint, suggesting the API reference isn't packaged for easy machine/AI consumption beyond human-readable docs. Missing for 10: a public OpenAPI/swagger schema, explicit SDK/AI-agent integration guidance, and independent developer corroboration of API completeness.
